name: Corniche & Harbour
hero_subtitle: An easy evening promenade with fish restaurants, blue boats and Atlantic air — Asilah’s social waterfront.

overview.title: Where Asilah meets the sea
overview.p1: The corniche and small harbour are where locals and visitors gather after the medina and sunset. Blue fishing boats, grilled fish and a simple promenade set the mood.
overview.p2: It is the easiest place in Asilah for a seafood dinner with ocean air. Casual stalls and sit-down restaurants sit side by side.
overview.p3: Come after the ramparts sunset for a natural end to the day.
